question.:question/problem:
Which of the following elementary row operations transforms the matrix $A$ into the matrix $B$, where

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}5 & 1 & -3 \\ -8 & 0 & 2 \\ 10 & 5 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}5 & 1 & -3 \\ -8 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & 1\end{bmatrix}?
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, notice that the $1$st and $2$nd rows are the same in both matrices. The only row that has changed is the $3$rd row.

By considering the given row operations that modify the $3$rd row, we notice that

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\begin{bmatrix}5 & 1 & -3 \\ -8 & 0 & 2 \\ 10 & 5 & -5\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-2)\cdot {R}_{1} \\ & \sim\begin{bmatrix}5 & 1 & -3 \\ -8 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & 1\end{bmatrix} \\ & =B.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-2)\cdot {R}_{1}.
$$

$$
K=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 4 & -2 \\ 0 & -4 & -1 \\ 1 & 3 & 2\end{bmatrix}
$$

$$
L=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 10 & 2 \\ 0 & -4 & -1 \\ 1 & 3 & 2\end{bmatrix}?
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, notice that the $3$rd and the $2$nd rows are the same in both matrices. The only row that has changed is the $1$st row. 

By considering the given row operations that modify the $1$st row, we notice that

$$
\begin{aligned}K & =\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 4 & -2 \\ 0 & -4 & -1 \\ 1 & 3 & 2\end{bmatrix}\,{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+2\cdot {R}_{3} \\  & ∼\begin{bmatrix}0 & 10 & 2 \\ 0 & -4 & -1 \\ 1 & 3 & 2\end{bmatrix} \\  & =L.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+2{R}_{3}.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Which of the following elementary row operations transforms the matrix $X$ into the matrix $W$, where

$$
X=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 6 & 10 \\ 1 & -1 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 5\end{bmatrix}
$$

$$
W=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 6 & 10 \\ 1 & -1 & 22 \\ 0 & 0 & 5\end{bmatrix}?
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, notice that the $1$st and $3$rd rows are the same in both matrices. The only row that has changed is the $2$nd row.

By considering the given row operations that modify the $2$nd row, we notice that

$$
\begin{aligned}X & =\begin{bmatrix}2 & 6 & 10 \\ 1 & -1 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 5\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+5{R}_{3} \\ & \sim\begin{bmatrix}2 & 6 & 10 \\ 1 & -1 & 22 \\ 0 & 0 & 5\end{bmatrix} \\ & =W.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+5{R}_{3}.
$$
